outcome_free_power_screen.estimand: delta_i = sum(q_k^2)-sum(p_k^2)+2*(p_b-q_b), positive when candidate p has lower multiclass Brier loss
outcome_free_power_screen.method: Outcome-blind simulation. Null I draws b_i independently from Categorical(q_i); Null C draws b_i independently from Categorical(p_i). Each replicate combines its simulated row-delta vector with independent target_date and market_id multinomial pigeonhole counts, shared between the two nulls.

outcome_free_power_screen.null_c_power_result: NO_GO_UNPOWERED: abs(mean delta) 0.138516107473012 does not exceed MDE 0.1571149069447749

future_outcome_protocol_if_and_only_if_o.primary_estimand: Mean paired multiclass Brier improvement, Brier(incumbent q, y) minus Brier(candidate p, y), on the 368 frozen rows.
future_outcome_protocol_if_and_only_if_o.realized_band_access: The realized band b may be materialized only after a separate operator alpha allocation and immutable freeze of this draft.
future_outcome_protocol_if_and_only_if_o.inference: At least 10,000 crossed target_date x market_id pigeonhole-bootstrap draws with shared row weights and mean +/- q*SE at q=3.1098893; no percentile interval.
future_outcome_protocol_if_and_only_if_o.predeclared_sharper_subset: The 254 rows where sum(p_k^2)-sum(q_k^2) > 0 in the checksum-pinned arm-vector CSV. This subset is fixed before any outcome read.
future_outcome_protocol_if_and_only_if_o.sharpening_guard: On the fixed sharper subset, define candidate_closer_i = 1 only when the realized paired delta_i is strictly positive; exact ties count 0. Using the same crossed target_date x market_id weights, require candidate_closer_share minus 3.1098893 times its crossed bootstrap SE to exceed 0.5. Failure is NO_GO.
future_outcome_protocol_if_and_only_if_o.accept_rule: Intersection-union rule: accept for further confirmation only if every integrity control passes, the paired improvement point is positive, mean improvement minus 3.1098893 times its crossed bootstrap SE is greater than zero, and the sharpening guard passes. Otherwise NO_GO. A mean win cannot pass alone.
